title: Dune Allen "Allen Overlook" 98 Woodward Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $35 per day.- 5 adult bikes- Elevator- 6- Passenger golf cart- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Sun-soaked coastal fun awaits at Allen Overlook. This 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom Dune Allen escape comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with multiple communal spaces. Indulge in lackadaisical days relaxing in the outdoor spaces, swimming in the private pool, and unwinding on the beach—only a 7-minute walk away.Designed for socializing, the first floor of this 3-level home offers a vast living area with a comfy sectional, Smart TV, and convenient wet bar. Large windows and glass doors fill the space with natural light and lead to the backyard. Sip lemonade in the sheltered sitting area, spread out on the sun loungers, or cool off in the pool’s sparkling waters. At the end of the night, retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. For convenience, a laundry room is on this level.Venture to the second-level great room, elegantly adorned with shiplap walls and pale wood floors. A soft couch and armchairs beckon guests to sit back for an evening watching TV or catching up in the living space. High-end appliances and spacious counters provide a beautiful workspace for crafting cuisine in the kitchen. There’s space for everyone to savor group meals thanks to a round table for 6, a dining table for 8, and 4 stools at the breakfast bar. The deck, outfitted with a patio loveseat, 8-person table, and a gas grill, encourages morning coffee and afternoon barbecues in the breezy air. This level features a guest bedroom with a king bed and a charming bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunks.Continue up to the third floor to discover a wet bar with a Keurig Pod coffee maker—perfect for all-hours refreshment. There is a guest and primary bedroom, each with a king bed and a private bathroom. The primary bedroom boasts a private balcony with a spiral staircase to the furnished crow’s nest featuring Gulf and lake views.Allen Overlook’s quick beach access and outdoor amenities make for a delightful Dune Allen getaway. Easily explore with on-site parking and 5 complimentary adult bikes. The nearest beach access is Dune Allen Beach Access on County Highway 30A. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Bonus Living Area that Leads to PoolSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and management fines.

This 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom Dune Allen escape comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with multiple communal spaces. Indulge in lackadaisical days relaxing in the outdoor spaces, swimming in the private pool, and unwinding on the beach—only a 7-minute walk away. There is a guest and primary bedroom, each with a king bed and a private bathroom. The primary bedroom boasts a private balcony with a spiral staircase to the furnished crow’s nest featuring Gulf and lake views. Allen Overlook’s quick beach access and outdoor amenities make for a delightful Dune Allen getaway. Easily explore with on-site parking and 5 complimentary adult bikes. The nearest beach access is Dune Allen Beach Access on County Highway 30A. Book today!
